facts.bandage: A man with a white bandage around his head stands holding one wand in both hands.
facts.wary-look: He turns his head and looks to the side as if on guard.
facts.eight-fence: Behind him, eight wands stand in a row like a fence.
facts.clothes: He wears reddish-brown clothes and pale greenish boots.
facts.landscape: Behind are green hills and a blue sky, and the ground under his feet is a pale gray.

glosses.bandage: A wound already taken once, yet still standing.
glosses.eight-fence: The defenses and experience built up so far.

reversedGloss.waning: The strength to hold on has run out, and rest is needed.
reversedGloss.excess: Wariness goes too far, and he blocks everything.

misdescriptions.wrong: All nine wands stand behind him.
